🇷🇺⚔️🇺🇦Russian Defense Ministry on progress of special military operation 11 May 2026 ❗️ In accordance with the decision of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, during the holidays on the occasion of the 81st anniversary of the Great Victory, all groups of the Russian troops in the special military operation zone continue to strictly observe the ceasefire since 00:00 of 8 May remaining in previously taken positions. ▪️ Despite the announcement of a ceasefire regime, the Ukrainian armed formations carried out strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles and conducted artillery fire against the Russian positions. ▪️ Over the past day, the Armed Forces of Ukraine have made 12 attempts to launch attacks and have carried out 767 strikes against Russian troops using MLRSs, artillery guns, and mortars. They delivered 6,905 strikes using unmanned aerial vehicles. ▪️ In total, 23,802 ceasefire violations by the Ukrainian side were recorded during the ceasefire period in the special military operation zone. ▪️ Moreover, the enemy delivered strikes at civilian facilities in Belgorod region, using 18 UAVs, including eight fixed-wing ones and 10 copters. Two local residents were wounded. Three motor vehicles, one store building, one apartment building, and two private houses were damaged. ▫️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have mirrored the actions of the AFU. Retaliatory fire was carried out on MLRS positions, artillery, and mortar positions. Command and control posts and launch points of unmanned aerial vehicles were engaged. In response to the enemy's fire attacks, units of the Sever Group of Forces hit manpower and hardware of the AFU mechanized brigade near Zapselye (Sumy region). In Kharkov region, units of two mechanized brigades of the AFU and one territorial defense brigade were neutralized by fire close to Ryasnoye, Shesterovka, and Budarki (Kharkov region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 90 troops, five motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns. In the course of the retaliatory strikes, units of the Zapad Group of Forces hit formations of two mechanized brigades of the AFU close to Krestishche and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 90 troops, two armored fighting vehicles, 20 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns, including two Western-made ones. The Yuzhnaya Group's units repelled three attacks launched by assault groups of two mechanized brigades and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Konstantinovka, Khimik, Artema and Ray-Aleksandrovka (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to over 70 troops, six armored fighting vehicles, 15 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns. The Tsentr Group of Forces repelled nine attacks launched by AFU assault groups and hit by retaliatory fire manpower and hardware of two mechanized brigades, one airmobile brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Novoleksandrovka, Kucherov Yar, Lenina, Belitskoye, (Donetsk People's Republic), Novopavlovka, and Novopodgorodnoye (Dnepropetrovsk region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 305 troops, six armored fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, and two artillery guns. In response to the enemy's fire attacks, units of the Vostok Group of Forces inflicted fire damage on formations of one air assault brigade, two assault brigades, and two assault regiments of the AFU close to Verkhnaya Tersa, Charivnoye, and Vozdvizhevka (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 320 troops, one armored fighting vehicle, and four motor vehicles. The Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanized brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU close to Preobrazhenka and Zaporozhets (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ Up to 45 troops, 17 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun were neutralized. Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, and missile troops of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation didn't deliver strikes. ▫️ Air defense systems shot down 85 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles. In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost: - 671 aircraft, - 284 helicopters, - 144,888 unmanned aerial vehicles, - 661 anti-aircraft missile systems, - 29,260 tanks and other armored fighting vehicles, - 1,718 MLRS combat vehicles, - 34,864 field artillery guns and mortars, - 61,323 special military vehicles. US F-35 makes emergency landing in UAE A US Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II fighter jet operating near the Strait of Hormuz reportedly transmitted the emergency transponder code 7700 for the second time in 24 hours. After declaring the emergency this morning, the aircraft changed course from the direction of the Gulf of Oman toward the United Arab Emirates. The jet stopped transmitting while in UAE airspace and made a hard landing at Al-Dhafra Air Base. US officials have not yet issued a statement.

Продовжуємо фактично щоденно бути в комунікації з представниками Сполучених Штатів. Сьогодні Рустем Умєров доповідав за підсумками зустрічей зі Стівом Віткоффом і Джаредом Кушнером. Важливо, що Америка залишається в дипломатії, і зокрема виступила посередником у питанні про обмін полоненими. На необхідному рівні тривають контакти, щоб погодити конфігурацію обміну. Списки передані, і ми розраховуємо, що американська сторона буде активною в забезпеченні реалізації цієї домовленості. Були обговорені в Америці й можливі формати зустрічей і перемовин на рівні лідерів для завершення російської війни. Окремо й детально Рустем доповів по контактах із країнами, які зацікавлені в Drone Deals з Україною. Вже близько 20 країн у роботі на різних етапах: чотири угоди вже підписані, і в рамках цих угод готуються перші контракти, з іншими країнами тривають підготовчі процедури для політичних домовленостей, які відкриють шлях бізнесу. Зараз Україні вже гарантовані перші енергетичні результати завдяки цим угодам – необхідний обсяг пального на українському ринку забезпечується. Будуть і вагомі фінансові результати. Окрім Близького Сходу та Затоки, Південного Кавказу та Європи, незабаром відкриємо таку нову безпекову співпрацю в рамках Drone Deals з іще однією частиною світу. Готуємо новини – позитивні для України. Слава Україні!

We continue our nearly daily communication with representatives of the United States. Today, Rustem Umerov briefed me on the outcomes of his meetings with Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. Importantly, America remains engaged in diplomacy and, in particular, has acted as a mediator on the issue of a prisoner exchange. Contacts are ongoing at the appropriate level to hammer out the configuration of the exchange. The lists have been handed over, and we expect the American side to play an active role in ensuring the realization of this agreement. Possible formats for meetings and negotiations at the leadership level aimed at ending Russia’s war were also discussed in the United States. Rustem also provided a separate detailed report on contacts with countries interested in Drone Deals with Ukraine. Nearly 20 countries are currently involved at various stages: 4 agreements have already been signed, and the first contracts under these agreements are now being prepared. With other countries, preparatory procedures are underway for political arrangements that will open the way for businesses. Ukraine has already secured its first energy-related results thanks to these agreements – the Ukrainian market is being supplied with the necessary volume of fuel. There will also be significant financial results. In addition to the Middle East and the Gulf, the South Caucasus, and Europe, we will soon launch this new security cooperation within the framework of Drone Deals with another part of the world as well. We are preparing positive news for Ukraine. Glory to Ukraine!

A thousand years ago, the first of many attacks on Somnath took place. Those who kept engaging in such attacks believed they could shatter the ethos of our land. But, they were wrong. Thanks to fiercely courageous children of Bharat Mata, Somnath kept getting rebuilt. Seventy-five years ago on this day, the doors of the newly rebuilt Somnath Temple opened in the presence of the then President Dr. Rajendra Prasad, proclaiming to the world that while the attackers have faded into the dust of history, the soul of Bharat endures. Somnath stands tall and eternal. It showcases our civilisational courage and our unbroken devotion. May the blessings of Mahadev always remain upon us all.

The modernisation and expansion of the United Nations Office at Nairobi is a powerful expression of inclusivity, geographical balance and the universality of the United Nations system. To complement the modernisation of the UN campus, we are investing $1.1 billion in complementary support for Nairobi’s infrastructure upgrade, including roads, street lighting, regeneration of the Nairobi Rivers, ICT systems security, and the operationalisation of the UN One-Stop Shop. This investment affirms Nairobi’s role as the UN’s headquarters in the Global South, a centre of international diplomacy, and a symbol of international cooperation. Additionally, we are modernising the Bomas Convention Complex to strengthen Kenya’s position as a hub for international conferencing.

Broke ground for the construction of the expanded United Nations Office at Nairobi Assembly Hall, Gigiri, and inaugurated the new United Nations Office block alongside UN Secretary-General @antonioguterres.

Karkonoski Park Narodowy powiększy się o 113 hektarów! Jego częścią stanie się obszar niezwykle cennych przyrodniczo Stawów Podgórzyńskich. Właśnie dokonaliśmy wykupu tego obszaru, było to możliwe dzięki darowiźnie Fundacji Drzewo i Jutro, z którą Park współpracuje od 2023 roku. Stawy Podgórzyńskie pełnią rolę retencyjną i przeciwpowodziową, posiadają unikatowe walory przyrodnicze, historyczne, kulturowe i krajobrazowe. To jeden z najcenniejszych obszarów wodno-błotnych Kotliny Jeleniogórskiej. Spotkać można tam około 180 gatunków ptaków. To też istotny element korytarzy ekologicznych łączących Karkonosze z Kotliną Jeleniogórską. Stawy mają również wysoki potencjał edukacyjny i turystyczny, dlatego nabycie tego obszaru przez Karkonoski Park Narodowy jest ważnym wydarzeniem!

We are a country where the Inspector General of Police appears unaware that law enforcement cannot raid or attack buildings without a proper warrant. Where the Planning Minister and Finance Minister rarely sit together, compare notes, or align their strategies. Where The Finance Minister openly states that the IMF essentially writes his budget and that he must seek permission for major decisions. Meanwhile, the Planning Minister offers no credible growth strategy—only ad-hoc, foundationless policies that lack vision or substance. Too many ministries operate without clear purpose or competence. The Education Ministry, for instance, busies itself with interfering in autonomous institutions, restricting their ability to actually teach rather than enabling excellence. Parliament routinely passes laws without reading them, without meaningful debate, and without addressing the serious challenges confronting the nation. Academia produces little genuine research and offers almost no practical ideas or solutions to the country’s pressing problems. Civil society remains largely disengaged—focused primarily on weddings, funerals, and performative roles as speakers and audiences at donor-funded conferences that generate more talk than impact. Foreign lenders and consultants routinely shape policy to suit their own priorities rather than the needs and aspirations of the country’s people. And the judiciary frequently (but after decades of deliberation) undermines contracts and economic value through rulings that show little regard for economic analysis or a coherent understanding of law and economics. This is a system marked by fragmentation, lack of accountability, and institutional drift—where form often replaces function, and short-term expediency crowds out long-term national interest.

महाराष्ट्र परिवर्तनाचा भाग नव्हे, परिवर्तनाचे नेतृत्व करणारे राज्य! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज नवी दिल्ली येथे 'CII ॲन्युअल बिझनेस समिट 2026' येथे सीआयआयचे महासंचालक चंद्रजीत बॅनर्जी आणि सीआयआयचे अध्यक्ष राजीव मेमानी यांच्यासमवेत 'व्हिजन फॉर इंडिया@ 100' या विषयावर संवाद साधला. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, बऱ्याचदा असे क्षण येतात, जेव्हा एखादा देश केवळ बदलाचा भाग राहत नाही, तर स्वतः परिवर्तनाचा मार्ग दाखवतो. आज भारत अशाच निर्णायक टप्प्यावर उभा असून जगाला नवी दिशा देत आहे. जगभरात अनिश्चिततेचे वातावरण असताना भारत जागतिक स्तरावर भक्कमपणे उभा आहे. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या दूरदर्शी नेतृत्वामुळे गेल्या 10 वर्षांत जगाचा भारताकडे पाहण्याचा दृष्टिकोन पूर्णपणे बदलला असून, स्थिर धोरणे, मोठी स्वप्ने आणि प्रभावी कामगिरीमुळे आज भारताला जागतिक स्तरावर नवी ओळख मिळाली आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. 'The Viksit Bharat Abhiyan-India @ 100' हे 2047 पर्यंत भारताला विकसित राष्ट्र बनवण्याचे महत्त्वाकांक्षी ध्येय आहे. हे ध्येय साध्य करण्यात राज्यांची भूमिका अत्यंत महत्त्वाची आहे. वेगवान विकास, व्यापक प्रगती आणि परिवर्तनशील दृष्टिकोनाच्या जोरावर महाराष्ट्र या प्रवासात आघाडीवर राहील, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्रात देशातील सर्वात मोठी जीसीसी परिसंस्था विकसित झाली असून देशातील सुमारे 24% जीसीसी परिसंस्था एकट्या महाराष्ट्रात आहे. तसेच, महाराष्ट्र आशियातील सर्वात महत्त्वाच्या डेटा इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर कॉरिडोरपैकी एक म्हणून उदयास येत आहे. एआय, सेमीकंडक्टर्स, ईव्ही, स्वच्छ ऊर्जा, डेटा सेंटर्स, जीसीसी आणि डीप-टेक हे भविष्यातील अर्थव्यवस्थेची दिशा ठरवणार असून महाराष्ट्र या परिवर्तनाच्या केंद्रस्थानी उभा राहत आहे. भविष्यातील उद्योग अशा ठिकाणांना प्राधान्य देतील, जिथे हरित ऊर्जा, उत्कृष्ट पायाभूत सुविधा, सक्षम पुरवठा साखळी आणि पर्यावरणपूरक विकासाला चालना मिळेल. महाराष्ट्रातही अशाच प्रकारची जागतिक दर्जाची व्यवस्था उभारली जात असून, येथे स्थिर धोरणे, जलद निर्णयप्रक्रिया आणि विश्वासार्ह अंमलबजावणी सुनिश्चित केली जात असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @CB_CII @rajivmemani @FollowCII #NewDelhi #DevendraFadnavis #CIIAnnualBusinessSummit26

اسلام آباد : 11 مئی، 2026 وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے وزارت انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی و ٹیلی کام کے امور پر جائزہ اجلاس کی صدارت کی. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ملک میں آئی ٹی کے شعبے کا فروغ اور آئی ٹی سے متعلق برآمدات میں اضافہ حکومت کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے. پاکستان کے نوجوانوں میں آئی ٹی کے حوالے سے بے پناہ استعداد موجود ہے جس سے بھرپور استفادہ حاصل کیا جانا چاہئیے. وزیراعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ گلگت بلتستان اور آزاد جموں و کشمیر میں آسان خدمت مراکز کے قیام کے حوالےسے کام تیز کیا جائے. آسان خدمت کی سہولیات کو صوبوں میں بھی شروع کرنے کے حوالےسے صوبائی حکومتوں کے ساتھ مل کر کام کیا جائے. آئی ٹی کے شعبے میں شہری اور دیہی علاقوں کے درمیان فرق کو کم کرنے کے لئے صوبائی و ڈسٹرکٹ کی سطح پر حکومتوں کا تعاون حاصل کیا جائے۔ اجلاس کو ملک میں آئی ٹی کے فروغ کے حوالے سے اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ ملک بھر میں گھریلو انٹرنیٹ کنکشنز کی تعداد 2024 میں 1.9 ملین سے بڑھ کر 2026 میں 5.10 ملین ہوگئی ہے۔ رواں مالی سال پاکستان سے 4.5 سے 4.6 بلین امریکی ڈالرز کی آئی ٹی برآمدات متوقع ہیں. بریفنگ میں مزید بتایا گیا کہ حال ہی میں پاکستان میں 5 جی سروسز کے لئے نیلامی کی گئی جو کہ اس حوالے سے 2016 سے اب تک ہونے والی دنیا کی سب سے بڑی نیلامی تھی؛ اس آکشن سے پاکستان کو 509 ملین امریکی ڈالرز کا ریونیو حاصل ہوا. مصنوعی ذہانت کے فروغ کے حوالے سےفروری 2025 میں انڈس اے آئی ویک کا اہتمام کیا گیا ؛ 30 شہروں میں تقریبات ہوئیں. انڈس اے آئی ویک میں 100 سے زائد بین الاقوامی مندوبین نے شرکت کی ؛ 88 پویلیئنز بنائے گئے. اسلام آباد کے سرکاری اسکولوں اور ہیلتھ یونٹس کو فائبر کنیکٹیویٹی فراہم کر دی گئی ہے. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ اسلام آباد کو فری انٹرنیٹ ہاٹ اسپاٹس کی فراہمی کا کام حتمی مرحلے میں ہے. سید پور ماڈل ویلج اور فاطمہ جناح پارک میں ای-لرننگ پاڈز (E-learning pods) نصب کئے جا رہے ہیں. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزیر منصوبہ بندی احسن اقبال ، وفاقی وزیر قانون و انصاف اعظم نذیر تارڑ ، وفاقی وزیر اقتصادی امور احد خان چیمہ ، وفاقی وزیر انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی و ٹیلی کام شزہ فاطمہ خواجہ ، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ و ریلوے بلال اظہر کیانی اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی ۔ Video

India and Pakistan have long been strategic rivals, but their military doctrines differ sharply. Pakistan traditionally follows a policy of strategic ambiguity — revealing only enough military capability to deter adversaries while keeping its full capabilities uncertain. India, by contrast, increasingly projects an image of power that often exceeds its demonstrated capabilities. The recent controversy surrounding the alleged test of the Agni-6 intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) reflects this divergence. Large sections of the Indian media, amplified by political messaging from the ruling Narendra Modi government and the Bharatiya Janata Party, celebrated the missile launch as a historic breakthrough. Reports claimed India had tested a 10,000-kilometre-range nuclear-capable ICBM capable of striking anywhere in the world. BJP social media campaigns even declared that India was entering the league of global superpowers. Yet the available evidence tells a different story. The Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) issued before the launch restricted airspace over a corridor of roughly 3,560 kilometres — significantly below the range associated with a true ICBM and even lower than the publicly discussed capabilities of the Agni-5 system. Several respected Indian defence commentators, including Shekhar Gupta and Snehesh Alex Philip, criticised the exaggerated claims, warning that hyper-nationalist “chest-thumping” damages India’s credibility internationally. More importantly, the timing and location of the test suggest political signalling rather than technological transformation. Conducted shortly after the BJP’s political gains in West Bengal and launched from the Odisha coast, the missile was reportedly visible from parts of Bangladesh, including Dhaka and Chattogram. This has led to speculation that the test was designed not only to signal strength toward Pakistan and China, but also to send a symbolic message to Bangladesh amid changing regional politics and the rise of Hindutva-driven nationalism in eastern India. #IndiaOut Ultimately, the controversy reveals how defence achievements in South Asia are increasingly intertwined with domestic politics, media sensationalism, and regional psychological signalling.

सोमनाथ पुनर्निर्माण के 75 गौरवशाली वर्ष पूर्ण होने के पावन अवसर पर आदरणीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi जी की गरिमामयी उपस्थिति में आज सम्पूर्ण राष्ट्र “सोमनाथ स्वाभिमान पर्व” मना रहा है। इस ऐतिहासिक अवसर पर आदरणीय प्रधानमंत्री जी ने श्री सोमनाथ मंदिर में पूर्ण विधि-विधान के साथ पूजा-अर्चना एवं जलाभिषेक किया। यह केवल एक मंदिर के पुनर्निर्माण की यात्रा नहीं, बल्कि भारत की सनातन चेतना, सांस्कृतिक स्वाभिमान और राष्ट्रीय आत्मगौरव के पुनर्जागरण का अमर प्रतीक है। इस ऐतिहासिक अवसर के लाइव प्रसारण में सम्मिलित हुई और चांदनी चौक स्थित प्राचीन गौरी शंकर मंदिर में पूजा-अर्चना एवं जलाभिषेक कर देवाधिदेव महादेव से समस्त देशवासियों के सुख, समृद्धि और कल्याण की प्रार्थना की। सोमनाथ केवल एक मंदिर नहीं, बल्कि भारत की अखंड आस्था और आध्यात्मिक शक्ति का प्रतीक है। अनगिनत आक्रमणों और विध्वंसों के बाद भी सोमनाथ का पुनर्निर्माण यह संदेश देता है कि भारत की संस्कृति, श्रद्धा और सनातन चेतना शाश्वत है। आदरणीय प्रधानमंत्री जी के नेतृत्व में आज भारत “विकास भी, विरासत भी” के मंत्र के साथ अपनी सांस्कृतिक पहचान को नए वैभव के साथ पुनर्प्रतिष्ठित कर रहा है। काशी विश्वनाथ से केदारनाथ और महाकाल लोक से सोमनाथ तक, यह कालखंड भारत की सांस्कृतिक चेतना के पुनर्जागरण का साक्षी बन रहा है। इस अवसर पर कैबिनेट सहयोगी श्री प्रवेश साहिब सिंह जी, श्री मनजिंदर सिंह सिरसा जी, श्री कपिल मिश्रा जी सहित बड़ी संख्या में श्रद्धालु उपस्थित रहे। हर हर महादेव जय सोमनाथ @p_sahibsingh @mssirsa @KapilMishra_IND #SomnathVirasatK75Varsh

The main ukrainian 🇺🇦 challenge for the next few months is to counter the massive air guided bombs (KAB) campaign. On the hottest area of the frontline (Hulialpole, Dobropilla and Sloviansk), Russia is constantly hitting everything with KABs. In total, I mapped 6 600 impacts for the last ~3 months on this 150 km long frontline. ▫️Near Hulialpole, I mapped around 1 687 FAB guided bombs impacts. The precision of those is around 80 to 90% hitting something (treelines, position, urban area). This is where the strike campaign is the most worrying, with an excellent precision and a high concentration of hits. ▫️On the Novopavlivka-Pokrovsk'e front, I mapped around 559 airstrikes impacts, which are much less numerous, focused on strongholds with a much lower precision (~20%). This is not an organized campaign but an usual use of these bombs. ▫️On the Pokrovsk-Dobropilla frontline (which extends to Kostiantynivka), I mapped around 3 500 FAB impacts, with most of them on the Dobropilla area. This is a real strike campaign but the precision is much less the case here, with around 20/30% hitting something and the remaining ones falling on the fields. ▫️Finally, the last studies area is the SLoviansk one. Here too, we can see a recent surge in strikes, with high concentration on key forests around the strategic village of Rai Oleksandrivka. Here, I counted ~820 impacts with a higher precision (~60%) since most are hitting forests. One thing to keep in mind is the number of monthly strikes. We have around 6 690 strikes reported for April in Ukraine and I mapped around 37% of those. Another interesting point is the fact that it's more difficult to find strikes impacts in cities, that's why you have less dots on Kostiantynivka, despite high KAB concentration there as per geolocated videos. Finally, for the precision of the strikes, I believe the precision is higher in Hulialpole because Ukraine cannot put electronic warfare easily, while the Donbas cities allow multiple EW equipments to be installed. For the precision, you have to take into account that only 5 to 15% of the strikes "hitting something" are in fact hitting their intended target, soldiers, bunkers or trenches.

🇷🇺🇺🇸 In commemoration of the 81st anniversary of Victory in the Great Patriotic War, Russian compatriots living in the United States and concerned Americans held a series of memorial events. They laid wreaths and flowers at memorial sites dedicated to the immortal feat of the Soviet people and the heroic Red Army, which broke the back of Hitler’s war machine in combat brotherhood with the USA and the countries of the anti-Hitler coalition: • the ALSIB heroes memorial in Fairbanks, Alaska; • Fort Richardson National Cemetery in Anchorage, Alaska - the graves of Soviet pilots and sailors who participated in ferrying aircraft to the USSR under the Lend-Lease program; • the monument to Soviet soldiers in Plummer Park, Los Angeles, and the memorial bench in Lincoln Park, San Francisco, California, honoring warriors who fell in World War II battles; • the memorial stone to Red Army soldiers in Beaverton, Oregon, where more than 150 bricks engraved with the names of Soviet veterans have been laid in the park complex; • the burial site of Red Navy sailor M.I.Anisimov at Evergreen Washelli Cemetery in Seattle, Washington; • in Washington, D.C. - the “Spirit of the Elbe” bas-relief and the “Murmansk” inscription dedicated to the Allied Arctic convoys. Following a cherished tradition, activists of the Russian diaspora organized “Immortal Regiment” processions, motorcades, the “St. George’s Ribbon” campaign, meetings with veterans, film screenings, and festive concerts in the states of Washington, Illinois, New York, Connecticut, and Texas. In Florida, they opened the thematic exhibition “We Remember, We Are Proud, We Honor!”, where one of the halls in a Miami bookstore recreated the chronicle of the war years with displays of copies of Soviet publications from 1941–1945. 🎖 We thank everyone who reverently, proudly, and boldly honors the memory of the Soviet soldier-liberator, who saved the world from the brown plague, and refuses to let the combat alliance of our countries during the grim years of the war be forgotten — an alliance that is especially relevant today for normalizing Russian-American relations and for our joint struggle against manifestations of Nazism in modern Europe. Deep bow to the Generation of Heroes! No one is forgotten, nothing is forgotten, and nothing is forgiven!

“Drones upset this entirely. A $100 drone flown by a teenager can take out a lifetime of training and all the support behind it.” Andrew Côté (@Andercot) To be an Armored Knight in the middle ages was a combination warlord, oligarch, and olympic athlete all in one. Training began in youth, at age 12, and required daily practice with sword, lance, pike, on horse and on foot. Longbow men upset this drastically at Agincourt. The armor worn by a knight would cost the same as a large house today, perhaps more, and training was a full time job. To fire a longbow you could be a yeoman, a forester, a skilled peasant, essentially. It did require practice, and started young: from age 12, but practing only one day a week, or a few days a month, mandated by law. Muskets changed this entirely. You could learn to fire a musket in a few weeks of training, and it required no real athleticism. The hardest part was discipline and drill, marching in formation, volley fire, but the weapon itself no longer required a dedicated lifetime of athleticism. Special Forces soldiers are more like knights in the comparative requirements for their athleticism, equipment, and support - for every SF operator theres a dozen or more logistics and support personnel, like squires to a knight. Drones upset this entirely. A $100 drone flown by a teenager can take out a lifetime of training and all the support behind it. In this April 13th post, I articulated the structural constraints that Iran and the US have in their negotiations. Iran's counter-proposal today and Trump's rejection are operating based on these constraints. Majid Hosseini (@m4h007) As I said before the negotiations, Trump isn’t anywhere near accepting Iran’s terms, nor is America’s political establishment. Trump was desperate to get an off-ramp from his threat, so he pretended to accept Iran’s terms, but went in with his own terms and didn’t make any meaningful concessions. From what I can see these are the constraints on each side: ***Iran*** For Iran, this war and everything that has proceeded it is about its sovereignty. That’s the only lens through which one has to look at Iran from 1979 to today. A revolution, decades of sanctions, and three wars have been the price Iranians have been willing to pay to assert their sovereignty. They could have maintained a nice lifestyle and good relations with the US if they wanted to give up their sovereignty. As such, any trading of sovereignty for comfort would be considered unacceptable for Iranian people. They’ll ask, what was the point of so much suffering, if we wanted to give up any of our rights. What are the issues that directly affect Iran’s sovereignty? Uranium Enrichment: A sovereign right that is part of being an NPT member. Iranians might be willing to give up enrichment for a short few years, in return for major concessions, but more than that is giving up sovereignty and thus deemed unacceptable. Even just a short period will affect training and keeping up with better tools and equipment and thus it’s a very significant concession. Control over the Strait of Hormuz: Iran considers the strait part of its territorial waters and has never conceded broad rights regarding it under any treaty. It treats the strait as a matter of sovereignty, law, and national security. Collecting a toll is something it considers a sovereign matter, not something to be negotiated with others or shared with a non-neighboring party like the US, or other GCC states besides Oman, which shares the other shore. Even the suggestion of such demands would be seen as an attempt to usurp Iranian sovereignty and would be completely unacceptable Support for its allies: This is also a sovereign matter. No country will accept an order from others about which entities to have a relationship with. ***US*** Trump cannot accept Iran’s sovereign rights. Accepting those is an admission of defeat. The entire point of this war has been removing Iran’s sovereignty. This isn’t just about Trump. It’s an institutional constraint within the US. Iran can only exist as a client state, or one that can be attacked at will, or shouldn’t exist altogether. Sovereign equality for Iran is fundamentally unacceptable. I don’t see this constraint changing anytime soon. America’s political system is almost entirely behind this. Even if Trump made such a concession, there’s zero chance it could pass the US congress. Israel is part of the issue, but I don’t believe it’s all because of Israel. As long as the Carter Doctrine hasn’t been completely repudiated, and Persian Gulf hasn’t been conceded to Iran, this won’t change. As such there’s no path to a settlement through negotiations. Perhaps in a generation or two. Soon, consumer prices will force US hand to withdraw from active belligerent status, Iran will officially keep charging a toll for passage through the strait moving forward, and a state of war between Iran and Israel will persist in the background. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/m4h007/status/2043912995865276781#m

🇷🇺🇺🇸 In commemoration of the 81st anniversary of Victory in the Great Patriotic War, Russian compatriots living in the United States and concerned Americans held a series of memorial events. They laid wreaths and flowers at memorial sites dedicated to the immortal feat of the Soviet people and the heroic Red Army, which broke the back of Hitler’s war machine in combat brotherhood with the USA and the countries of the anti-Hitler coalition: • the ALSIB heroes memorial in Fairbanks, Alaska; • Fort Richardson National Cemetery in Anchorage, Alaska - the graves of Soviet pilots and sailors who participated in ferrying aircraft to the USSR under the Lend-Lease program; • the monument to Soviet soldiers in Plummer Park, Los Angeles, and the memorial bench in Lincoln Park, San Francisco, California, honoring warriors who fell in World War II battles; • the memorial stone to Red Army soldiers in Beaverton, Oregon, where more than 150 bricks engraved with the names of Soviet veterans have been laid in the park complex; • the burial site of Red Navy sailor M.I.Anisimov at Evergreen Washelli Cemetery in Seattle, Washington; • in Washington, D.C. - the “Spirit of the Elbe” bas-relief and the “Murmansk” inscription dedicated to the Allied Arctic convoys. Everyone knows about the 300 Spartans at Thermopylae. Almost nothing they know is the full story. Start with the number. There weren't 300 Greeks at that pass. There were around 7,000. Spartans, Thespians, Thebans, Phocians, Locrians, Arcadians, Corinthians. Citizen-soldiers from across Greece who marched north knowing they'd be facing the largest army the ancient world had ever assembled. The 300 is just the headline. The ones who stayed to the end. Now the men themselves. King Leonidas wasn't some chiseled 30-year-old. He was roughly 60 years old when he led that march. And the 300 he picked weren't his strongest warriors. They were specifically men who already had living sons. Spartan law demanded it. Leonidas wasn't choosing an army. He was choosing men whose bloodlines could survive their deaths. Every one of them knew what that meant before they ever saw a Persian. They marched anyway. And they didn't march alone in the way movies suggest. Each Spartan citizen-soldier was accompanied by helots, the enslaved underclass that propped up the entire Spartan economy, outnumbering their masters roughly seven to one. Hundreds of helots fought and died at Thermopylae too. They get no statues. No films. No name on the monument. The pass itself was barely 15 meters wide in 480 BC (it's silted up now and looks nothing like it did then). That bottleneck is the only reason a few thousand men could hold off a Persian force modern historians estimate at 70,000 to 300,000. Herodotus said 1.7 million. He was lying, or possibly counting cooks, slaves, and camp followers, but even the conservative number is staggering. For two days, they held. Wave after wave broken against bronze and discipline. Xerxes reportedly leapt from his throne three times in fury watching his men die. He sent in the Immortals, his elite personal guard, supposedly invincible. They weren't. Not in that pass. Then the Greeks were betrayed. A local man named Ephialtes, whose name still means "nightmare" in modern Greek, sold the Persians a goat path through the mountains that flanked the pass. The Phocians assigned to guard it scattered when the Immortals appeared in the dawn fog. Leonidas knew by morning he was surrounded. He dismissed most of the allied Greek forces. Saved their lives. But here's what almost nobody talks about: roughly 700 Thespians, led by a man named Demophilus, refused to leave. They were citizen-farmers from a small town that knew Persia was coming for them next no matter what. They chose to die beside the Spartans rather than run. About 400 Thebans stayed too, though their motives were murkier and many surrendered when the end came. So the "last stand of the 300" was actually closer to 1,500 men. The Thespians died to the last. Their town was burned to the ground by the Persians weeks later anyway. They're a footnote in a story that should bear their name. The final fight happened on a small hill called Kolonos. Spears shattered. Swords broken. Herodotus says they fought with hands and teeth at the end. Leonidas fell early, and the Spartans fought four times over his body to keep the Persians from taking it. They lost. Xerxes had Leonidas decapitated and his body crucified, a violation of Persian custom so extreme it tells you exactly how badly that old man had humiliated the king of kings. Forty years later, Sparta sent a delegation to recover his bones and bring him home. Two Spartans survived the battle. One, Aristodemus, had been sent away with an eye infection. He returned to Sparta and was treated as a coward, shunned, refused fire, refused conversation, until he threw himself into the front line at Plataea a year later and died seeking redemption. The other survivor, Pantites, was sent on a diplomatic errand and missed the fight. He hanged himself from the shame. That's the world they lived in. The epitaph carved at the site doesn't brag. It doesn't even mention victory, because there wasn't one. Roughly translated, it just asks the traveler to tell Sparta that her sons died here, obedient to her laws. A small group of farmers, an old king, an enslaved underclass written out of history, and a town that vanished from the map. Together, for three days in August of 480 BC, they did the math on freedom and decided the price was worth it. We remember 300 of them. There were always more.

Biman Bangladesh Airlines has just signed a 3.7 billion dollar order with Boeing for fourteen new aircraft, including eight 787-10 Dreamliners, two 787-9s, and four 737 MAX 8s. The national carrier is doubling its fleet and will soon become the only South Asian operator flying the entire 787 family. The country was born in 1971. Now look at Pakistan. PIA today owns 30 aircraft of which only 18 are in operation , the direct heir to Orient Airways founded in Calcutta in 1946 and the airline that wet leased Emirates its first Boeing 737 in 1985. Its new owners are scouting the second hand market for roughly twenty used jets, ten in 2026 and ten in 2027 . AirSial, Airblue, and Fly Jinnah operate a handful of narrowbodies between them. Not one Pakistani carrier has placed a direct factory order for a new widebody in more than two decades. This is the shame of an aviation industry whose heritage predates Partition itself. We trained the Gulf. We helped launch Emirates. We were the second ranked airline in the world in the 1960s. And today we are being outpaced in fleet renewal by a country that was once our own eastern wing. Bangladesh is buying Dreamliners. Pakistan is renting hand me downs. The numbers do the talking.

China is actually desperately dependent on the dollar. Its own currency is not freely convertible because of strict capitol controls. Think of Chinese currency as 'Mao-nopoly' money, not really useful in the real world. UnveiledChina (@Unveiled_ChinaX) China has been telling the world it is abandoning the dollar. The Council on Foreign Relations just published a detailed analysis showing that China may actually hold more dollars off its official books than on them. The de-dollarization story is largely a magic trick. Here is how it works in plain terms. China's official foreign exchange reserve, managed by an agency called SAFE, used to hold about 79% of its assets in US dollars back in 2005. By 2019, that number had dropped to 55%. That is the number that gets reported. That is the number that generates headlines about China dumping the dollar. But while China was reducing the dollar share of its official reserves, it quietly stopped growing those official reserves altogether. They have been stuck at roughly $3.3 trillion for eight years. All the new money China accumulated went somewhere else entirely, into the foreign lending of state-owned policy banks like the China Development Bank, into the foreign assets of state commercial banks, and into various state investment funds. None of this is fully disclosed. None of it shows up in the headline de-dollarization numbers. CFR senior fellow Brad Setser ran the math. China's official reserves hold approximately $1.8 trillion in dollars. But Chinese state commercial banks hold an estimated $1 trillion in dollar assets abroad. The policy banks hold close to another $1 trillion in foreign claims, most denominated in dollars. The China Investment Corporation, the country's sovereign wealth fund, holds roughly $450 billion in foreign assets, the majority in dollars. Add it all up and China's total dollar holdings across all state entities likely exceed $4 trillion, more off the official books than on them. Every debt restructuring case where China's policy banks were involved, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Ecuador, Angola, involved dollar-denominated loans. Not yuan. Not euros. Dollars. The de-dollarization narrative serves a specific purpose for Beijing. It signals geopolitical independence from the US financial system, which is valuable messaging for domestic audiences and Global South partners. But the actual financial behavior of Chinese state entities tells a different story. China's banks are still borrowing and lending predominantly in dollars. China's investment funds are still holding predominantly dollar assets. The label changed. The exposure did not. China is telling the world it is exiting the dollar while quietly holding more of it than ever. For week 2 of our Freedom 250 campaign, we’re highlighting another transformational milestone in the history of our capital markets: the invention of the stock ticker. A quick history lesson below ⬇️📚 Before stock tickers, brokers relied on messengers running handwritten slips of paper between exchanges and brokerage offices. In 1867, Edward Calahan created a system of telegraphy that converted stock-price signals into stamped codes on ticker tape, significantly speeding up the transfer of information. This new invention brought heightened accuracy and efficiency to a previously slow and more vulnerable stock trading system. After the technology was adopted by the New York Stock Exchange, the stock ticker quickly became the new operating standard for market participants as the first real-time electronic information network in the United States. It expanded access to price data and inspired new financial strategies. New ideas and developing technology are key to facilitating market growth and capital formation in an ever-evolving economy. Throughout its history, the SEC has worked to embrace and encourage innovation—not ignore or stifle it—to ensure our financial markets remain the deepest and most liquid in the world. Here’s to 250 more years of brilliant ideas and American prosperity! 🇺🇸 @Freedom250

Used boat prices are collapsing. There are now insane deals on boats that only need a little TLC. So are people rushing to buy them? Nope. My brother spoke with a New York boatyard manager we've known for 35 years who specializes in 30-50 foot motorboats. When he started, most owners repaired and maintained their own boats. He says 2008 wiped those guys out. Today his yard handles 90% of the maintenance and repair. What’s fascinating is COVID brought in a younger generation willing to work on their own boats… but most failed. He says millennials have more theoretical knowledge than any generation before them thanks to YouTube. The problem is they can’t translate that knowledge into hands-on skill. First, they order the wrong parts. Wrong parts kill boat projects. With local chandlers gone, one bad screw means waiting 24 hours for West Marine or Amazon… and suddenly a Saturday repair becomes next weekend’s problem. He thinks AI maybe could help translating parts lists and scoping out projects. Second, they struggle with basic mechanical skills: how to hold a wrench at the right angle, back off a nut without dropping it into the bilge, or manipulate tools in tight spaces. Many get frustrated and quit too easily. Some try to jump into difficult projects that look easy on YouTube instead of starting with simple things like changing the oil or repairing a handrail. Worse, endless YouTube tutorials make them overthink simple problems. And because there are no DIY people left in the yard there’s nobody to share a beer with at lunch and trade advice. Meanwhile dock fees have exploded. Even if you get a steal on the boat itself, many middle-class buyers can’t afford to keep it. Regulations don’t help either. In the 1990s plenty of people impulse-bought boats and learned as they went. Today many states require online boating safety courses first. That friction kills spontaneity, and the courses often exaggerate danger enough to scare people away entirely. His yard is still full, but repair work is falling because people barely use their boats. Some come back at the end of the season with single-digit engine hours. Owners are terrified of scratches, docking mistakes, or becoming the next viral marina fail on Instagram. He said the best old school boat handlers he knows had the biggest fiberglass repair bills while they were learning. When people do shown up with damage today they are often embarrassed for no reason. But according to Chris, the biggest problem is simple: cheap travel. Why spend invest time in mastering a new skill when you can book a $199 flight to tourist destination where you learn nothing more than how to follow the herd to the next instagram photo spot?

En el barrio el Remanso I, localidad de Bosa, el alcalde Galán intenta desalojar a 431 familias. ¿Quién está detrás? Propietarios de Transmilenio Dime quién financia tu campaña y te diré para quién gobernarás. No hay progreso sin justicia. Y menos Cuando cientos de NIÑOS pueden terminar en la calle por favorecer intereses particulares. Leamos lo que escribe la compañera “Ana Cristina Muñoz” *El Remanso I: la Bogotá que expulsa a sus pobres* En El Remanso I, barrio de San Bernardino, en la localidad de Bosa en Bogotá, no solo intentan arrasar viviendas. Buscan arrasar la esperanza de más de 400 familias que levantaron su vida sobre un territorio que hoy quieren arrebatarles. Después de catorce años de sueños construidos, el alcalde Carlos Fernando Galán decidió darles la espalda para ponerse del lado del poder económico. Detrás del desalojo aparece Sotrandes, empresa privada operadora de rutas troncales y zonales del Sistema Integrado de Transporte Público de Bogotá, Transmilenio. En esta ciudad parece valer más el capital privado que la vida. El desalojo es un acto político de despojo. Revela qué intereses protege realmente la alcaldía. Mientras la propiedad privada recibe todas las garantías, la dignidad humana y el derecho a una vivienda digna son ignorados. Galán y sus funcionarios se lavan las manos en el fallo judicial que reconoció la propiedad privada del terreno. Pero la pregunta persiste: ¿señor alcalde por qué tanta diligencia para defender intereses económicos y tan poca para proteger a quienes habitan el territorio? La respuesta está en el uso selectivo de la ley: implacable con los pobres y complaciente con los poderosos. En El Remanso I, el verdadero drama es desalojar a la fuerza sin ofrecer alternativas dignas y humanas. Detrás de cada casa que quieren destruir hay una familia y un derecho que debe ser reconocido. Lo más doloroso es la frialdad con la que todo ocurre. Funcionarios que dicen “cumplir una sentencia judicial”, empresas que hablan de legalidad y autoridades que reducen la vida humana a un trámite administrativo. Así opera la deshumanización: convertir personas en obstáculos y comunidades enteras en daño colateral aceptable para que avance el negocio. Y mientras tanto, la alcaldía de Bogotá sigue hablando de progreso. Pero no puede llamarse progreso a dejar niños durmiendo en la calle. No puede llamarse desarrollo a destruir comunidades para incrementar ganancias. No puede llamarse justicia a un sistema donde una empresa tiene más garantías que una familia pobre. Nada de esto es casual. Responde a la lógica que atraviesa el mundo: la deshumanización. La misma que le permite al doctor Galán negar un genocidio transmitido en vivo desde Gaza. Porque cuando se aprende a negar la humanidad del otro en lugares remotos, también se vuelve más fácil negarla en el propio territorio. La historia demuestra que la deshumanización siempre precede a la violencia. Hannah Arendt lo advirtió: la maldad se planifica en oficinas, se ejecuta por funcionarios en silencio, se disfraza de legalidad y así nadie se siente culpable. Mientras tanto, cientos de familias bogotanas pierden su hogar. Con Iván Cepeda vamos por una revolución ética que ponga la vivienda digna y la vida de la ciudadanía primero Video

This: >>China is telling the world it is exiting the dollar while quietly holding more of it than ever. That is not de-dollarization but a very well-executed press release. ...tells us China is far more vulnerable to distant blockade in the event an attempted invasion of Taiwan in Fall 2027 than anyone has believed previously. UnveiledChina (@Unveiled_ChinaX) China has been telling the world it is abandoning the dollar. The Council on Foreign Relations just published a detailed analysis showing that China may actually hold more dollars off its official books than on them. The de-dollarization story is largely a magic trick. Here is how it works in plain terms. China's official foreign exchange reserve, managed by an agency called SAFE, used to hold about 79% of its assets in US dollars back in 2005. By 2019, that number had dropped to 55%. That is the number that gets reported. That is the number that generates headlines about China dumping the dollar. But while China was reducing the dollar share of its official reserves, it quietly stopped growing those official reserves altogether. They have been stuck at roughly $3.3 trillion for eight years. All the new money China accumulated went somewhere else entirely, into the foreign lending of state-owned policy banks like the China Development Bank, into the foreign assets of state commercial banks, and into various state investment funds. None of this is fully disclosed. None of it shows up in the headline de-dollarization numbers. CFR senior fellow Brad Setser ran the math. China's official reserves hold approximately $1.8 trillion in dollars. But Chinese state commercial banks hold an estimated $1 trillion in dollar assets abroad. The policy banks hold close to another $1 trillion in foreign claims, most denominated in dollars. The China Investment Corporation, the country's sovereign wealth fund, holds roughly $450 billion in foreign assets, the majority in dollars. Add it all up and China's total dollar holdings across all state entities likely exceed $4 trillion, more off the official books than on them. Every debt restructuring case where China's policy banks were involved, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Ecuador, Angola, involved dollar-denominated loans. Not yuan. Not euros. Dollars. The de-dollarization narrative serves a specific purpose for Beijing. It signals geopolitical independence from the US financial system, which is valuable messaging for domestic audiences and Global South partners. But the actual financial behavior of Chinese state entities tells a different story. China's banks are still borrowing and lending predominantly in dollars. China's investment funds are still holding predominantly dollar assets. The label changed. The exposure did not. China is telling the world it is exiting the dollar while quietly holding more of it than ever. Africa remains central to @IFAD's investment model, with nearly 60% of our core resources directed to the continent. That is why I am in #Nairobi for the Africa Forward Summit. At a time of growing geopolitical fragmentation, fiscal pressure and contracting aid flows, the conversation taking place here is an important one - how to mobilize investment, build productive sectors, expand opportunity and create jobs. At the Summit, it means I will be advancing three priorities: • Positioning agriculture and rural economies where they belong: at the centre of economic policy, as drivers of growth, employment, stability and resilience. • Strengthening IFAD’s role as a co-investment platform capable of crowding in greater public and private investment at the first mile of food systems, where investment has the greatest multiplier effect. • Building strong momentum for #IFAD14 and reinforcing the global case for sustained investment in rural economies. The discussions I will be having with African Heads of State, partners and the private sector reflect a shared understanding, development must increasingly be driven by investment, implementation and economic transformation. #FinancingTheFirstMile | #AfricaForward

As Chairman Atkins pointed out, AI is part of a long line of "mind-aiding instruments" that have transformed the global economy, from the telegraph to the electronic order book. While the pace of this innovation is undeniably new, the process of integrating it into our capital markets is a familiar challenge. En el barrio el Remanso I, localidad de Bosa, el alcalde Galán intenta desalojar a 431 familias. ¿Quién está detrás? Propietarios de Transmilenio Dime quién financia tu campaña y te diré para quién gobernarás. No hay progreso sin justicia. Y menos Cuando cientos de NIÑOS pueden terminar en la calle por favorecer intereses particulares. Leamos lo que escribe la compañera “Ana Cristina Muñoz” *El Remanso I: la Bogotá que expulsa a sus pobres* En El Remanso I, barrio de San Bernardino, en la localidad de Bosa en Bogotá, no solo intentan arrasar viviendas. Buscan arrasar la esperanza de más de 400 familias que levantaron su vida sobre un territorio que hoy quieren arrebatarles. Después de catorce años de sueños construidos, el alcalde Carlos Fernando Galán decidió darles la espalda para ponerse del lado del poder económico. Detrás del desalojo aparece Sotrandes, empresa privada operadora de rutas troncales y zonales del Sistema Integrado de Transporte Público de Bogotá, Transmilenio. En esta ciudad parece valer más el capital privado que la vida. El desalojo es un acto político de despojo. Revela qué intereses protege realmente la alcaldía. Mientras la propiedad privada recibe todas las garantías, la dignidad humana y el derecho a una vivienda digna son ignorados. Galán y sus funcionarios se lavan las manos en el fallo judicial que reconoció la propiedad privada del terreno. Pero la pregunta persiste: ¿señor alcalde por qué tanta diligencia para defender intereses económicos y tan poca para proteger a quienes habitan el territorio? La respuesta está en el uso selectivo de la ley: implacable con los pobres y complaciente con los poderosos. En El Remanso I, el verdadero drama es desalojar a la fuerza sin ofrecer alternativas dignas y humanas. Detrás de cada casa que quieren destruir hay una familia y un derecho que debe ser reconocido. Lo más doloroso es la frialdad con la que todo ocurre. Funcionarios que dicen “cumplir una sentencia judicial”, empresas que hablan de legalidad y autoridades que reducen la vida humana a un trámite administrativo. Así opera la deshumanización: convertir personas en obstáculos y comunidades enteras en daño colateral aceptable para que avance el negocio. Y mientras tanto, la alcaldía de Bogotá sigue hablando de progreso. Pero no puede llamarse progreso a dejar niños durmiendo en la calle. No puede llamarse desarrollo a destruir comunidades para incrementar ganancias. No puede llamarse justicia a un sistema donde una empresa tiene más garantías que una familia pobre. Nada de esto es casual. Responde a la lógica que atraviesa el mundo: la deshumanización. La misma que le permite al doctor Galán negar un genocidio transmitido en vivo desde Gaza. Porque cuando se aprende a negar la humanidad del otro en lugares remotos, también se vuelve más fácil negarla en el propio territorio. La historia demuestra que la deshumanización siempre precede a la violencia. Hannah Arendt lo advirtió: la maldad se planifica en oficinas, se ejecuta por funcionarios en silencio, se disfraza de legalidad y así nadie se siente culpable. Mientras tanto, cientos de familias bogotanas pierden su hogar. Con Iván Cepeda vamos por una revolución ética que ponga la vivienda digna y la vida de la ciudadanía primero Video

When a man identifying himself as Chris Chen reached out this winter to an aide on a House committee focused on threats from China, he came armed with a lucrative offer. The staff member, Chen proposed, could earn $10,000 or more by barely lifting a finger. All he would need to do is agree to phone calls every other week to share information about the committee’s work and US foreign policy about China. Insights into US trade or national-security issues, including the Trump administration’s plans for Venezuela in the aftermath of the January military operation there, would be especially valuable, Chen said. To sweeten the pot, Chen repeatedly promised to send the aide $2,000 up front. The offer seemed too good to be true. Instead of quietly accepting the deal, the aide reported it to his bosses on the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party. The panel quickly concluded Chen was not the Singapore-based business consultant he claimed to be, but instead likely a Chinese intelligence officer or contractor seeking a new recruit. Rather than cut off contact, the committee’s Republican majority staff agreed to keep talking to Chen. They recorded a series of calls this winter to learn more about Chen’s tactics and interests. Transcripts of those calls depict a determined, at times impatient, individual eager to earn the trust of his mark and get down to business. Chen mixes holiday greetings with elaborate questions about manufacturing in Vietnam and Mexico and the future of Venezuela’s oil industry. The outreach by Chen to an aide on the very committee responsible for investigating Chinese national-security threats appears to provide an unusually vivid portrait of how Beijing’s spy services seek to gain access to sensitive information from within the corridors of power in Washington. After about two months of conversations with Chen, the House committee referred the matter to the FBI, which has been tracking increasingly brazen intelligence-gathering operations by China. “China and other foreign governments are using professional networking social media sites to target people with US government security clearances.” Seeking to cultivate a source in the heart of a congressional committee dedicated to addressing the threat from China would be an especially audacious move. Chen first contacted the staff member in Dec from a Gmail account with a display name of Kris Chen, though he signed his emails with the spelling Chris. He described himself as an employee of NimbusHub Strategic Consulting, a Hong Kong-based firm with a spartan website that promises “to provide clients with the tools and knowledge necessary to navigate an increasingly complex global landscape.” The website contains filler text in Latin, which often auto-populates within unfinished sections of websites. Other clues point to NimbusHub as a front for China’s spy services. In a Feb report on malicious uses of its AI tools, OpenAI identified ChatGPT users who had used the model to generate email drafts purporting to be from employees of NimbusHub. The emails addressed to state officials in the US and policy analysts working in business and finance came from personas who, like Chen, sought to offer paid consulting gigs for information. The small number of users, whom OpenAI later banned, told ChatGPT to flatter their targets and sent their prompts in simplified Chinese characters, the standard writing system in China, rather than traditional Chinese characters, which Hong Kong continues to use. “They requested the email drafts to be concise, clear, and professional, with subject lines that created urgency and used subtle psychological cues.” The profile picture for Chen’s 1/n nytimes.com/2026/05/09/us/po…

If social media posts of Judge Hamayoun Dilawar are authentic (Tosha Khana Case Judge), this is alarming and raises serious and reasonable doubts on credibility of trial being conducted by him. In my view, propriety demands that he should immediately recuse or disassociate himself from the case. It needs to be noted that Seven Member Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in Malik Qayyum Case (reported in 2001 PLD SC 568) held that bias on part of the judge vitiates judicial proceedings. The court further held that an accused has a right of a fair trial by a judicial minded person, not by someone functioning under an influence or bias as the same paralyses his judicial faculties to conduct fair trial. Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

Had the honour of hosting President Julius Maada Bio of Sierra Leone at State House Nairobi, and welcomed him to Kenya for the Africa Forward Summit that begins on Monday. Kenya and Sierra Leone maintain strong and close ties anchored on mutual respect, pan-Africanism and regional stability. Our two governments will continue working together to advance our mutual interests and the African agenda. This includes championing reform of the international financial architecture, global governance especially at the United Nations Security Council, and climate action. The summit provides a suitable forum for the exchange of ideas and views on these issues. Also informed President Bio of Kenya's candidature for the position of judge of the International Criminal Court. Requested him to favourably consider supporting our candidate, Supreme Court Judge Njoki Ndung'u.

African financial institutions, including the African Development Bank Group, are critical to the achievement of the ambitious goals that the continent has set itself. The Bank has remained a steadfast partner in Kenya’s development journey, supporting transformative investments in roads, water infrastructure, hospitals, and other critical projects that continue to improve the lives of the citizens of our country. Kenya fully supports the Bank’s drive to unlock Africa’s potential through the New African Financial Architecture Framework. This bold initiative seeks to reduce the cost of capital, strengthen the continent’s financial sovereignty, and mobilise sustainable resources to advance the aspirations of Agenda 2063. Held talks with African Development Bank Group President Sidi Ould Tah, State House Nairobi, ahead of the Africa Forward Summit to be held in our capital city beginning Monday.

संजीव अरोड़ा एक ऐसे नेता हैं जो न सिर्फ़ ईमानदार और मेहनती हैं, बल्कि पंजाब के लिए उनके पास एक स्पष्ट विज़न, गहरी समझ और बदलाव का जुनून भी है। मंत्री बनने के बाद उन्होंने पंजाब में industrial investment लाने के लिए जिस गंभीरता और गति से काम किया, उसकी आज हर तरफ़ चर्चा है। पंजाब के किसी भी industrialist से पूछ लीजिए- शायद ही कोई ऐसा मिले जो संजीव अरोड़ा की industry policy और उनके काम करने के तरीके की तारीफ़ न करता हो। उन्होंने शहरों को साफ़-सुथरा और व्यवस्थित बनाने के लिए बड़े स्तर पर काम शुरू किया- street lights से शहरों को रोशन करने, सड़कों और गलियों में फैले बिजली के तारों के जाल को व्यवस्थित करने और आधुनिक urban infrastructure खड़ा करने की दिशा में लगातार काम किया। हाल ही में गाँवों और खेतों में फैले नंगे बिजली के तारों को underground करने की मुख्यमंत्री Bhagwant Mann की महत्वाकांक्षी योजना को ज़मीन पर उतारने की जिम्मेदारी भी संजीव अरोड़ा ही पूरी मेहनत और प्रतिबद्धता के साथ निभा रहे थे। ऐसे मेहनती, परिणाम देने वाले और visionary नेता को जब BJP झूठे मामलों में गिरफ्तार करती है, तो यह मामला सिर्फ़ एक नेता को परेशान करने का नहीं रह जाता - यह पंजाब की जनता के भरोसे, पंजाब के विकास और पंजाब के भविष्य के साथ धोखा बन जाता है। और पंजाबी अपने साथ तो क्या किसी दूसरे के साथ धोखा करने वाले को भी सबक सिखाना जानते हैं। Arvind Kejriwal (@ArvindKejriwal) किसी भी इंसान का चरित्र मुसीबत के समय पता चलता है। संजीव अरोड़ा ने बीजेपी में जाने की बजाय जेल जाना पसंद किया। उन्हें सलाम। — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/ArvindKejriwal/status/2053394772778524826#m

‼️🚨 ALARMING: Google now treats privacy as suspicious behavior by default. Users of GrapheneOS, CalyxOS, /e/OS, and other deGoogled Android phones are being locked out of millions of websites unless they install the exact Google Play Services software they deliberately removed. GrapheneOS is recommended by the EFF and used by journalists, lawyers, and activists in high-risk environments. The audience most likely to read Google's data practices and refuse its terms is now flagged as fraudulent for that exact decision. What happened?: ▪️ Google announced "Cloud Fraud Defense" at Cloud Next on April 22-23, 2026, branding it "the next evolution of reCAPTCHA." Existing reCAPTCHA customers were auto-migrated. ▪️ When the system flags traffic as suspicious, the old click-the-bus puzzle is gone. Users get a QR code instead. ▪️ Scanning the QR code requires Google Play Services running on the device. Internet Archive snapshots show this requirement has been live since at least October 2025, silently rolled out for 7 months before anyone noticed. ▪️ No Play Services = no QR scan = locked out. The bigger picture: ▪️ Google already tried this in 2023. It was called Web Environment Integrity (WEI), and it would have let Google decide which devices were "real enough" to access the web. Standards bodies and the public pushed back hard, and Google killed it. Three years later, the same idea is back, just hidden behind a QR code instead of a browser feature. ▪️ reCAPTCHA runs on millions of websites. Every developer who keeps using it is now, by default, telling deGoogled Android users they're not welcome...

#Hungary’s political transition presents the #EU with a narrow but critical window for strategic influence. In this new #ECFR commentary from @PiotrBuras1 and Pawel Zerka they outline six insights from a post-election Hungary. A new government under Peter Magyar is widely expected to shift Budapest closer to EU positions on Ukraine, Russia, and broader geopolitical alignment. But there are risks, if handled incorrectly. The core insight for decision-makers: Magyar’s mandate is primarily domestic. Hungarian voters are prioritising systemic reform at home over foreign policy realignment. This creates a sequencing challenge for the EU. The policy implication is not hesitation, but calibration. The EU should maintain conditionality and strategic pressure, while allowing political space for domestic consolidation. Supporting institutional reform and governance credibility in Hungary is not separate from geopolitical alignment. The question is no longer whether Hungary will change, but how the EU can calibrate and collaborate to ensure that change is both deep and lasting. Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif received a telephone call, earlier today, from His Excellency Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Jassim Al Thani, Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the State of Qatar. During their warm and cordial conversation, the two leaders exchanged views on the evolving regional situation and reviewed the progress of ongoing peace efforts in the region. The Prime Minister expressed Pakistan's sincere appreciation for Qatar's continued and steadfast support for Pakistan's peace initiatives, reaffirming the depth of the brotherly bonds between the two countries. Both sides underscored the importance of constructive engagement by all parties to ensure the success of ongoing peace efforts. The Prime Minister conveyed his warm regards to His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir of the State of Qatar, and stated that he was looking forward to the upcoming visit of His Highness the Amir to Pakistan. The visit of His Highness the Amir would help both sides to further strengthen and expand the enduring Pakistan-Qatar partnership.

The global semiconductor industry runs on chips. But chips run on something most people have never heard of — neon gas. And right now, the maritime system that moves it is dangerously fragile. A new paper by Chemi Rigzin of the National Maritime Foundation traces an overlooked vulnerability at the heart of global tech supply chains — and finds that India sits at a strategic crossroads it hasn't fully recognised yet. When Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022, it disrupted up to 54% of global semiconductor-grade neon supply overnight. Prices spiked ninefold. Taiwan — which manufactures 90% of the world's most advanced chips — depends on uninterrupted maritime deliveries of this gas, with an operational tolerance of just 7 to 14 days before fabrication lines stop. Here's what makes India's position remarkable: it already produces neon as a by-product of its steel industry. It just can't purify it to semiconductor grade. And its eastern seaboard is 7 to 10 days from Taiwan — compared to 25 to 30 days from Europe. The gap between where India is and where it could be is not geological. It is a policy choice. Turkish technology entrepreneur Selcuk Bayraktar has criticised a recently circulated controversial technology manifesto linked to ongoing debate around Palantir Technologies, warning that it reflects a mindset that reduces war, peace, and human life to optimisation problems and algorithmic outputs. Bayraktar, who serves as Chairman of the Board and Chief Technology Officer of Baykar, said such approaches remove conscience, morality, and human agency from decision-making, and treat reality as if it were a simulation processed through servers rather than lived human experience. He stressed that humanity cannot be reduced to a data source, controlled by a monopolistic spider web. He made the remarks during a speech at Saha Expo 2026 in Istanbul, the international defence, aviation and space industry fair, which brings together global defence, aerospace, and technology companies showcasing military systems and emerging technologies. Bayraktar contrasted the manifesto with what he described as a human-centred approach, saying society must resist such frameworks and instead build systems centred on justice, compassion, morality, and human dignity. His remarks come amid growing concern around Palantir Technologies and its controversial publications, which has drawn debate over the role of large-scale data systems across the West in governance, security, and warfare. There has been widespread concerns with Palantir over surveillance capabilities, military applications of data platforms, and the concentration of powerful intelligence tools in private hands. Video

Il y a 81 ans, le 8 mai 1945, la France sortait de l'obscurité. Pas par miracle. Par choix, le choix de ceux qui, au bord de l'abîme, refusèrent de se résigner. Des pêcheurs de l'île de Sein, aux engagés volontaires de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon. Des commandos Kieffer, aux tirailleurs venus d'Afrique et d'Asie. Des résistants de l'ombre aux marins du Casabianca. Mais aussi des combattants issus des colonies, tirailleurs, spahis, goumiers, tous ont eu un engagement exceptionnel. Des femmes et des hommes de tous âges, de toutes origines, unis par une seule exigence : ne pas subir, ne pas céder. C'est ce que le général Leclerc, en faisant ses adieux aux hommes de la 2e DB, appelait le « patriotisme agissant ». Aujourd'hui, alors que les derniers témoins nous quittent, cet héritage nous revient : non pas seulement commémorer, mais agir à la hauteur de ce qu'ils ont accompli. 📸 © ECPAD

On 9 May in Netanya on occasion of 81st anniversary of Victory in Great Patriotic War of 1941–1945 Ambassador of Russia to Israel Anatoly Viktorov took part in laying flowers at Monument to Red Army’s Victory over Nazi Germany. He congratulated hundreds people who gathered on Great Victory Day. He noted that this holiday has enormous global historical significance. Emphasized that soldiers of Red Army changed course of history by thwarting Axis powers’ plans for world domination and liberating dozens of countries in Europe and Asia. He recalled President of Russia Vladimir Putin’s words today at Victory Day Parade on Red Square, that it was the Soviet people, who restored sovereignty to many countries whose governments had capitulated to the invaders. Emphasized that the Nazis barbarically exterminated Jews solely because of their nationality and treated all peoples of Soviet Union in the same inhumane way. He recalled that on 19 April, Russia for the first time observed Day of Remembrance for Victims of Genocide of the Soviet People committed by the Nazis and their collaborators, which joined other somber dates of World War II, including those related to the tragedy of the Holocaust. Extended a heartfelt thank to 99-year-old veteran Zosim Traper, who was present at the ceremony, paid tribute to entire generation of veterans who fought, survived and triumphed. He noted that in 2025 Zosim Traper attended parade in Moscow marking 80th anniversary of Victory Day. He also shared his relatives’ warrior path: his father Dmitry Viktorov celebrated his 19th birthday on 8 May 1945 in Berlin; his father-in-law Evgeny Zavadsky finished his military service in Vienna. He noted that every family in former Soviet republics and in Israel has its own heroes who fought on front lines, whose memory will be passed down to future generations. He noted with satisfaction that Israel pays due tribute to veterans and that since 2017 it made 9 May a national holiday. Highlighted constructive cooperation with Israeli side on preserving memory of events of those years; preventing distortion of history; silencing of crimes committed by the Nazis and their collaborators. Noted that Russia never divided the victory into “ours” and “others”, remembers brotherhood in arms with all armies of anti-Hitler coalition; those who raised uprisings in concentration camps, participated in the European resistance. He highlighted enormous contribution of People’s Liberation Army of Yugoslavia, which for many years fought against elite units of Wehrmacht, while some 800,000 Serbs were subjected to genocide by Croatian Ustasa. He also recalled heroic struggle of Chinese people against Japanese invaders, during which tens of millions of people perished. He honored memory of Belarusian people, who lost a third of their population during Great Patriotic War, including 800,000 Jews. Event at the Monument marked culmination of “Immortal Regiment march in Netanya. Ceremony was attended by Ambassador of Armenia Arman Akopian, Ambassador of Kazakhstan Daulet Yemberdiyev, Ambassador of Serbia Miroljub Petrovich, Ambassador of Uzbekistan Jakhongir Aminov, Minister-Counselor of Embassy of China, senior diplomats from embassies of Azerbaijan and Belarus, Head of Russian Ecclesiastical Mission in Jerusalem Archimandrite Vassian, Director of Russian House in Israel Diana Magad, Honorary Consul of Kyrgyzstan Dmitry Shkaf, students and teachers of the School at Russian Embassy in Israel. Flowers were laid by representatives of Coordinating Council of Russian-speaking Compatriots’ Organizations, “Israeli Anti-Fascist Movement,” Netanya Committee of War Disabled, Association of Afghanistan Veterans, Union of World War II Veterans – Fighters Against Nazism, Association for Sports and Cultural Initiatives, Israeli Association of Russian Compatriots, public associations “Bridge of Memory,” “Strength in Unity”, International Cultural Center for Immigrants “Friendship”.

China has a missile specifically nicknamed the "Guam Killer." The US just spent another $407 million making sure it lives up to that name only in the brochure. The US Missile Defense Agency awarded Lockheed Martin a $407 million contract modification on May 7, 2026, for continued engineering and development of the Aegis Guam System, pushing the total contract value past $1.9 billion. The work runs through December 2029 and covers adapting the Aegis ballistic missile defense system, proven on US Navy warships for decades, into a fixed land-based installation tailored specifically to Guam's threat environment. Guam sits approximately 3,000 kilometers from mainland China and hosts Andersen Air Force Base and Naval Base Guam, two of the most strategically critical US military installations in the Indo-Pacific. In any conflict over Taiwan, Guam is not a staging area. It is the logistics hub, the air power base, and the command node that US operations in the western Pacific depend on. China's People's Liberation Army Rocket Force knows this. The DF-26 intermediate-range ballistic missile, with a range of approximately 4,000 to 5,000 kilometers, was specifically designed and publicly nicknamed by Chinese military analysts as the "Guam Killer." China fields it in significant numbers alongside the hypersonic DF-17 and a growing inventory of cruise missiles that together form a saturation attack capability designed to overwhelm point defenses. The Aegis Guam System is the US answer to that saturation threat. It integrates with THAAD and Patriot batteries already on the island to create layered, 360-degree missile defense. The US conducted its first successful ballistic missile intercept from Guam using an SM-3 interceptor in late 2024. This contract funds the next phase of making that capability permanent, certified, and operationally validated. China cannot take Taiwan if it cannot neutralize Guam first. Neutralizing Guam requires overwhelming its defenses. Every additional layer of missile defense raises the number of missiles China needs to expend and the risk of mission failure. The $1.9 billion being invested in Aegis Guam is a deterrence calculation designed to make the opening move of any conflict more costly than Beijing can afford. The DF-26 exists because Guam matters. Aegis Guam exists because that missile exists. ‼️🚨 The official JDownloader website was breached, attackers swapped the Windows and Linux installers with malware for over a day before anyone noticed. JDownloader is a popular download manager with millions of users on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Timeline: ▪️ May 5, 23:55 UTC: attacker tests the method on a dummy page. ▪️ May 6, 00:01 UTC: real attack goes live. Alternative download links for Windows and Linux are replaced with malicious installers. ▪️ May 7: a Reddit user notices Windows SmartScreen flagging the installer with a strange publisher ("Zipline LLC", "The Water Team", "Peace Team") instead of "AppWork GmbH". ▪️ Hours later, the JDownloader dev team confirms the breach and takes the site offline. How they got in: an unpatched vulnerability let attackers modify the website's access control list (ACL), give themselves edit rights, and swap the download links. No further details on the bug have been shared. What's compromised: ▪️ Windows installer (alternative download links). ▪️ Linux shell installer (alternative download links). What's safe: ▪️ macOS installers (still validly signed). ▪️ The core JDownloader.jar file. ▪️ Flatpak, Winget, and Snap packages (separate infra, sha256 checksums unchanged). ▪️ In-app auto-updates (separate servers, end-to-end signed). If you downloaded JDownloader from the website between May 6 and May 7, treat your machine as compromised. This is the third trusted-software website breach in recent weeks, after Daemon Tools and CPU-Z / HWMonitor.
